description: Nexora Map is interactive command map for global map, built with full right-to-left (RTL) support. It runs completely offline — no map tiles, no geocoding, no external services. Region and governorate boundaries are embedded directly in the visual, so your data renders instantly and privately. Key features: - Embedded Saudi region and governorate boundaries. - Value-based region coloring (choropleth) with elegant glowing borders. - Drill from a region down into its governorates, with breadcrumb navigation. - Cross-filtering, selection, smooth zoom and pan, and interactive tooltips. - Two professional themes: Command (luxury charcoal/gold) and Relief (light paper with a hypsometric ramp). - Arabic or Western numerals, smart labels, full font control, and Arabic/English localization. - Official Saudi Riyal symbol (U+20C1) and percent/currency formats. Why Nexora Map? Traditional Power BI maps rely on external tile services that require connectivity and expose where your data is. Nexora Map is built for privacy-conscious, offline-first organizations: everything is embedded, nothing leaves your report. Ideal for: government command dashboards, geographic distribution reports, performance analysis by region/governorate, and region-level Vision 2030 indicators. A full 30-day trial is included.
